attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `yeaH`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 98% of them, at 0.15 bits.

**The rest of the window is fork and variable columns**, 1 to 79, carried by 52 to 89%, 69 persistent and 10 shell, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 82% of calls. A branch of 14 families runs through columns 1 to 14, a parallel path carried instead of the most carried families there, in 10 to 11% of chromosomes. The `astC` to `astE` genes, columns 36 to 40, are [[succinylglutamate metabolism]].

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 98 against 92%, and hesitates less there, 0.15 against 0.29 bits. Its most hesitant column, 8, `ydjL`, is a fork column, at 0.90 bits.

**The window ends on variable columns.** Columns 64 to 78, `thrS` to `hemP`, are carried by 74 to 84%, all persistent. The last column is `aroH`, in 63% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 93% of genes**, 0.29 bits on average, perplexity 1.4 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.22 against 0.16 bits, and names fewer genes, 66% against 96%.

label: yeaH
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yeaH window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yeaH, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,952 to 2,031 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yeaH once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.29 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 36,869 calls, named 97%, 0.14 bits; shell 5,915 calls, named 65%, 1.08 bits; cloud 176 calls, named 14%, 4.34 bits. Outside an RGP 37,996 calls, named 96%, 0.16 bits; inside an RGP 4,964 calls, named 66%, 1.22 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 55 fork, 24 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.22 against 0.16 bits) and names fewer genes (66% against 96%); 4,964 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 8 (ydjL, a fork column) 0.90 bits, RGP 82%; column 10 (ydjJ, a fork column) 0.87 bits, RGP 82%; column 9 (ydjK, a fork column) 0.78 bits, RGP 82%. The 8 columns (columns 8-15) where most calls are in an RGP: named 73%, 0.55 bits on average; the other 72 columns: named 95%, 0.26 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 98%, 0.15 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 92%, 0.29 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 8, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: yeaH "YeaH/YhbH family protein". named 98%; 0.15 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 52-89%, 69 P, 10 S, RGP 0-82%. named 25-99.6% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 9, named 25%; most hesitant at column 8, 0.90 bits.
[S2.b1]    a second branch of 14 families through columns 1-14, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-11%, all P; the branch's families: cdgI, dgcJ, yeaK, yoaI, yeaL, nimR, nimT, yeaO, yoaF, dgcP, yoaK, yoaJ, yeaQ, yoaG

[S2.b34]    a second branch of 25 families through columns 34-58, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11%, all P; the branch's families: yoaE, yoaL, manX, manY, manZ, yobD, mntP, rlmA, cspE, yobF, yebO, mgrB, yobH, kdgR, yebQ, htpX, prc, proQ, msrC, yebS, yebT, rsmF, yebV, yebW, pphA
